title: Mission Antyodaya Total Households — Assam Revenue Circles
description: Total number of households per Revenue Circle in Assam, from Mission Antyodaya 2020 survey data, used as a population exposure input to the IDS-DRR Assam flood risk model.
purpose: Household-count exposure covariate for the IDS-DRR Assam flood risk score model.
details: This is a single 2020 survey snapshot, not a time series. Catalogued separately from Sources/ANTYODAYA/metadata/rdls.json (which covers electricity/telecom/piped-water/sanitation/net-sown-area access) because total_hhd is 'Exposure' category per the risk model's data dictionary — a clean fit with RDLS's own exposure/population category — whereas the other Antyodaya indicators are 'Vulnerability' category there. License confirmed as 'CC BY 4.0' per the same dictionary.

gazetteer_entries.description: Assam Revenue Circles administrative boundaries (the object_id used across IDS-DRR variables) — a custom scheme, not yet a registered RDLS gazetteer.
